title: Q-GATE-403: the Worker gate checks nothing: GitHub answers 403 on the status of every open pull request
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** loop_beats row for gate with checked [] and errors on every PR (IDLE-IS-NOT-OK-1 marks it failed)
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/worker-gate.js::status 403
**Status:** open

code-task: repo=ultrastable/ultrastable path=seed/worker/src/worker-gate.js
code-anchor: if (!token) return { status: 'no-token', checked: [], errors: [] };

Live loop_beats, slot of 2026-11-15 19:40, loop gate: {status: errors, checked: [], errors: [ultrastable/ultrastable#424 status 403, #423 status 403, #419 status 403, #417 status 403, #416 status 403]}. The GitHub App token the Worker mints cannot write or read the status it needs, so ZERO-MINUTES-1 gates no pull request. Read the failing call in runGate, name the App permission it needs (statuses or checks), make a 403 on every PR one gate card GATE-APP-PERMISSION with the consent link (/connect/github) and a default in effect (the lane merges on local-checks evidence), and report the missing permission in checkRepoAccess so repo-access fails with the same reason instead of each PR failing separately.

size: M

**Closing probe:** grep:seed/worker/src/worker-gate.js::status 403
